environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The Flask app runs as a systemd service with the sqlite database at /var/data/app.db. No additional middleware or reverse proxy filtering is applied.

config.runtime: systemd service, Python 3.9, no request filtering
